content: A heartfelt farewell to Hon’ble Justice P.S. Bhati on his last day at Rajasthan High Court. Wishing him the very best as he takes charge as Chief Justice of the High Court of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh.
comment: A judicial transition of this stature also highlights the importance of continuity in institutional priorities, as every new leadership role carries the challenge of balancing reform with preserving public confidence in the system.
